language.script_notes: Both Latin and Cyrillic appear on signs, with Latin more common in daily use and Cyrillic on some official and older signs; the mixture helps separate it from purely Latin-script Croatia, Bosnia and Slovenia. The internet domain is .me.

road_furniture.bollard_color: White bollards with black caps and red rectangular sections.
road_furniture.bollard_shape: Slim white posts; stone blocks also mark curves in the mountains.
road_furniture.guardrail_type: Guardrails in mountainous areas are often black or yellow-painted and many look rusty; angular rails may appear near the border with Bosnia.
road_furniture.km_marker_style: EKO fuel stations (shared with Greece and the Balkans) and IDEA supermarkets (shared with Serbia) are common.

architecture.roof_style: Low-pitched red clay tile roofs on stone houses along the coast.
architecture.wall_construction: Whitewashed and stone houses against pale rocky hillsides; well-preserved medieval walled towns around the Bay of Kotor, including Kotor, Perast, Risan and Herceg Novi.
architecture.wall_color_palette: White and pale stone with red tile roofs.
architecture.distinctive_building_types: Walled medieval towns and Venetian-era stone palaces on the bay; stone houses on steep hillsides; Orthodox monasteries built into cliffs and hills.

nature.vegetation: Mediterranean scrub, olive and pine on the coast, dense beech and pine forest in the mountains, and bare limestone in the karst uplands.
nature.terrain: Very mountainous, with white, jagged rock faces, deep canyons and a rugged Adriatic coast; the Bay of Kotor is a winding fjord-like inlet unique to the country.
nature.climate_signature: Mediterranean on the coast, alpine and snowy in the mountains, with bright limestone light.

vehicles.plate_color: White plate with a blue strip on the left and the national crest in the centre, giving a subtle red accent; some older plain white plates survive.

google_coverage.blur_style: Image tiles often show visible cracks.
google_coverage.coverage_notes: Coverage follows the main roads, the coast and the mountain passes.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Cyrillic and Latin script, similar slim white bollards and Balkan architecture
confusion_set.tiebreaker: The red accent on the plate crest, black-capped bollards and rusty guardrails point here; Serbian bollards have an off-centre red reflector.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Neighbouring Adriatic karst coast and mountains
confusion_set.tiebreaker: The Cyrillic in the mix and the Bay of Kotor fjord landscape separate it from mostly Latin-script neighbours; Bosnian guardrails are angular.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Similar mountain terrain and concrete-and-stone architecture
confusion_set.tiebreaker: The red accent on this country's plates distinguishes it from Albania's and North Macedonia's plates.
